pop_india_total.source_name: UN World Population Prospects 2024, 1 July 2026 projection
pop_india_total.methodology_notes: Projected national population of 1,476,600,000 (~1.477B) as on 1 July 2026 from UN WPP 2024 Revision medium variant projection series.

digital_internet_users.methodology_notes: 1.03 billion unique people using the internet in India, pushing internet penetration to 70.0% of total population (~1.47B). Not derived from TRAI subscriber counts.

digital_internet_penetration.definition: Unique internet users as a percentage of total population (~1.47B)
digital_internet_penetration.methodology_notes: Internet penetration reached 70.0% of total population (1.03B out of ~1.47B) per DataReportal / Kepios (Oct 2025).

digital_urban_internet_users.definition: Active internet users residing in urban areas
digital_urban_internet_users.methodology_notes: 410 million active urban internet users (~76.6% penetration against ~535M urban population base). Sourced from IAMAI / Kantar Internet in India report.

digital_rural_internet_users.definition: Active internet users residing in rural areas
digital_rural_internet_users.methodology_notes: 548 million active rural internet users (~58.2% penetration against ~942M rural population base). Sourced from IAMAI / Kantar Internet in India report.

trai_telephone_subscribers_total.methodology_notes: 1,368.10 million gross telephone subscribers (1,319.19M wireless + 48.91M wireline). Measures gross subscriptions, not unique people.

digital_social_media_user_identities.definition: Active social-media user identities; may include multiple accounts per person
digital_social_media_user_identities.methodology_notes: 500 million active social-media user identities; may include multiple accounts per person. Equates to 34.1% of population (~1.47B) and 48.7% of internet users (1.03B). Do not label as unique people.

digital_youtube_ad_reach.source_name: Google / YouTube Advertising Reach via DataReportal 2026
digital_youtube_ad_reach.methodology_notes: 500 million YouTube advertising audience reach in India reported in DataReportal Digital 2026: India.

digital_instagram_ad_reach.methodology_notes: 481 million Instagram advertising audience reach in India reported in DataReportal Digital 2026: India.

digital_facebook_ad_reach.methodology_notes: 403 million Facebook advertising audience reach in India reported in DataReportal Digital 2026: India.

digital_snapchat_ad_reach.source_name: Snap Inc. Advertising Resources via DataReportal 2026
digital_snapchat_ad_reach.methodology_notes: 213 million Snapchat advertising audience reach in India reported in DataReportal Digital 2026: India.

digital_linkedin_members.methodology_notes: 170 million registered members (18+) in India reported in DataReportal Digital 2026: India.

digital_x_ad_reach.methodology_notes: 22.2 million X advertising audience reach in India reported in DataReportal Digital 2026: India.

digital_ott_subscribers.definition: Total paid OTT video streaming subscriptions in India across all platforms
digital_ott_subscribers.methodology_notes: 148M active paid subscriptions (Ormax 2025) to 216M gross bundled subscriptions (FICCI-EY).

digital_mobile_gaming_users.methodology_notes: 488 million online gamers in 2024, projected to reach 517 million in 2025 per FICCI-EY Media and Entertainment Report.

amfi_total_aum_cr.definition: Total assets under management in mutual funds.
amfi_total_aum_cr.methodology_notes: Assets under management is a stock metric, not annual inflows. Sourced from PwC India, Q3 FY26.

ev_sales_total.methodology_notes: Annual new electric vehicle registrations recorded on Vahan portal in FY2026. Flow metric.
ev_sales_total.definition: Annual registrations/sales, not the total number of EVs currently on Indian roads.

aai_domestic_passengers.methodology_notes: Monthly domestic passenger throughput. Flow metric.
aai_domestic_passengers.definition: Monthly and annual domestic air passenger traffic handled across Indian airports.

healthcare_expenditure_pct_gdp.source_name: National Health Accounts Estimates for India 2021–22

agri_total_foodgrain_production.source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (PIB 3rd Adv)

agri_rice_production.source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (PIB 3rd Adv)

agri_wheat_production.source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (PIB 3rd Adv)

bonus_rbi_repo_rate_2026.source_name: Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee

hero_digital_internet_users.methodology_notes: 1.03 billion unique internet users in India (70.0% penetration).

digital_internet_subscribers.methodology_notes: Includes fixed and wireless internet subscriptions; higher than internet users because one person may have multiple connections.

digital_broadband_subscribers.methodology_notes: Counts broadband data connections (>512 Kbps), not unique individuals.

digital_mobile_connections.methodology_notes: Active cellular mobile connections equating to 72.5% of total population (~1.47B). Not equal to smartphone users or unique mobile users.

digital_upi_monthly_transactions.definition: Monthly UPI transactions (Value: ₹29.82 lakh crore as of August 2026)
digital_upi_monthly_transactions.methodology_notes: Monthly UPI transactions reached 24.51 billion in August 2026, with a total value of ₹29.82 lakh crore (NPCI). Visible as of August 2026.

digital_upi_daily_transactions.definition: Daily average UPI transactions (August 2026 monthly volume ÷ 31)
digital_upi_daily_transactions.methodology_notes: Derived as August 2026 monthly volume (24.51B) ÷ 31 days = ~791M/day. Do not present this as a constant across all months.

digital_upi_annual_transactions.definition: Total annual UPI transactions for FY 2025–26 (Value: ₹314 lakh crore)
digital_upi_annual_transactions.methodology_notes: 24,161.69 crore total UPI transactions for FY2025–26 with aggregate value of ₹314 lakh crore.

upi_val_monthly.definition: Total value of UPI transactions in the month.
upi_val_monthly.methodology_notes: Total value of UPI transactions in the month. Flow metric.

fintech_credit_card_monthly_spend.definition: Total monthly spending on credit cards.
fintech_credit_card_monthly_spend.methodology_notes: Flow metric: total spending during the month. Note: UPI is a much larger payment rail by transaction count; credit-card spend is a separate consumer-credit metric.

fintech_credit_card_annual_spend.definition: Total annual spending on credit cards in the fiscal year.
fintech_credit_card_annual_spend.methodology_notes: Fiscal-year spend, not calendar-year spend. Flow metric.

fintech_credit_card_transactions.definition: Total credit-card transaction volume in the month.
fintech_credit_card_transactions.methodology_notes: Do not compare directly with UPI volume without noting the scale difference. Flow metric.

fintech_digital_lending_sanctions.definition: Cumulative sanctioned loan value via digital lending channels over past five years.
fintech_digital_lending_sanctions.methodology_notes: Measures sanctioned loan value over past five years, not annual market revenue or outstanding loans. Sourced from Redseer, Aug 2026.

fintech_india_market_size.definition: Fintech industry annual revenue market size.
fintech_india_market_size.methodology_notes: Market-revenue estimate; not comparable with UPI transaction value or lending sanctions. Projected USD 109.06B by 2031.

fintech_qr_code_deployments.definition: Total deployed merchant QR-code acceptance points across India.
fintech_qr_code_deployments.methodology_notes: Deployment/acceptance-point count, not unique merchant count. Stock metric. Sourced from PwC India, Q3 FY26.

ecommerce_e_retail_gmv_2025.definition: Gross merchandise value for India’s e-retail market; this is not the same as total e-commerce market size.
ecommerce_e_retail_gmv_2025.source_name: Bain & Flipkart, How India Shops Online 2026
ecommerce_e_retail_gmv_2025.methodology_notes: Primary market-size anchor for India's physical e-retail merchandise market. Excludes travel, food delivery, and digital services.

ecommerce_online_shopping_penetration.definition: Denominator is internet users (~1.03B), not India’s total population (~1.477B).
ecommerce_online_shopping_penetration.source_name: Bain & Flipkart, How India Shops Online 2026
ecommerce_online_shopping_penetration.methodology_notes: Online shoppers (290–300M) as a percentage of India's ~1.03B internet user base. Denominator is internet users.

ecommerce_annual_online_transacting_user.definition: Users who transacted online during the year across commerce, payments, travel, and services; not identical to online shoppers.
ecommerce_annual_online_transacting_user.methodology_notes: Users who completed at least one digital transaction during the year. Broader scope than physical e-retail online shoppers.

ecommerce_quick_commerce_gov_fy25.definition: Gross order value (GOV) across quick-commerce dark-store platforms (~$7.6B). GOV means gross order value; do not label as GMV unless source explicitly defines it as GMV.
ecommerce_quick_commerce_gov_fy25.methodology_notes: ~₹64,000 crore (~$7.6B) GOV across Blinkit, Instamart, Zepto, and BB Now in FY2025. GOV represents gross order value before cancellations/discounts.

ecommerce_quick_commerce_market_size.definition: Market-size estimates vary by methodology; other published 2026 estimates range from $3.65B to ₹1.90 trillion. Not the same metric as quick-commerce GOV.
ecommerce_quick_commerce_market_size.methodology_notes: Market size estimate of quick commerce industry revenues. Do not conflate with ₹64,000 Cr platform gross order value (GOV).

ecommerce_flipkart_market_share.definition: Market-share estimate is dated (FY2023); do not present as a current 2026 share.
ecommerce_flipkart_market_share.methodology_notes: FY2023 market share of Flipkart Group (including Myntra) in Indian physical e-retail GMV. Dated estimate; not current 2026.

ecommerce_amazon_market_share.definition: Market-share estimate is dated (FY2023); do not present as a current 2026 share.
ecommerce_amazon_market_share.methodology_notes: FY2023 market share of Amazon India in Indian physical e-retail GMV. Dated estimate; not current 2026.

ecommerce_mobile_share_of_b2c_value.definition: Refers to B2C transaction value, not the share of orders or users.
ecommerce_mobile_share_of_b2c_value.methodology_notes: 76.6% of Indian B2C e-commerce gross transaction value is transacted through mobile devices (smartphones/tablets).

ecommerce_active_stores_india.definition: Store count is not the same as seller count; verify source before presenting as official. Estimate — source required.
ecommerce_active_stores_india.methodology_notes: Estimated active storefronts and D2C online retail stores operating in India. Store count is not identical to marketplace seller count.

quickcommerce_quick_commerce_gmv_fy26.definition: Gross merchandise value for India’s quick-commerce market.
quickcommerce_quick_commerce_gmv_fy26.methodology_notes: Gross merchandise value for India’s quick-commerce market. Flow metric. Do not use older FY2025 figures ($7–8B) as the current market size.

quickcommerce_share_of_online_retail.definition: Share of India’s online retail, not total offline-plus-online retail.
quickcommerce_share_of_online_retail.methodology_notes: Share of India’s online retail, not total offline-plus-online retail. Stock metric.

quickcommerce_zepto_annual_transacting_u.definition: This is Zepto-specific and must not be shown as the total quick-commerce market.
quickcommerce_zepto_annual_transacting_u.methodology_notes: Annual transacting users reported by Zepto. Stock metric. Entity-specific; do not use as a market-wide user count.

quickcommerce_daily_orders_market.methodology_notes: Market-wide daily order run-rate across dark store quick-commerce platforms. Flow metric. Replaces older 2.5–3M orders/day figure.

quickcommerce_top3_annual_orders_fy26.definition: Top-three platform orders; not necessarily total market orders.
quickcommerce_top3_annual_orders_fy26.methodology_notes: Aggregated annual order count across Blinkit, Zepto, and Swiggy Instamart. Flow metric.

quickcommerce_total_dark_stores_2026.definition: Market estimate includes quick-fulfilment warehouses and dark stores; company-reported count covers only the three major platforms.
quickcommerce_total_dark_stores_2026.methodology_notes: Market estimate includes quick-fulfilment warehouses and dark stores; 4,525 dark stores reported by Blinkit, Zepto, and Swiggy Instamart in Q4 FY2026.

quickcommerce_yoy_gmv_growth_fy26.definition: Monthly year-on-year GMV growth; distinct from FY2026 annual growth or CAGR.
quickcommerce_yoy_gmv_growth_fy26.methodology_notes: Monthly year-on-year GMV growth in January 2026 (~100%). Distinct from FY2026 annual growth (~120% YoY GMV growth in FY2026). Flow metric.

ev_public_charging_points.definition: Charging points/chargers are individual charging connectors; not the same as charging stations.
ev_public_charging_points.methodology_notes: Total public EVSE connectors/chargers installed across India. Stock metric.

ev_evs_per_public_charger.definition: Denominator is public charging points/EVSE, not charging stations.
ev_evs_per_public_charger.methodology_notes: Ratio of electric vehicles in stock per public charging connector. Stock metric.

ev_2030_target.definition: Policy target for EV share of new-vehicle sales; not current penetration.
ev_2030_target.methodology_notes: National indicative EV adoption target for 2030 new vehicle sales. Stock / policy target.

ev_ride_hailing_rapido_mau.definition: App monthly active users; one person may use multiple mobility apps, so do not add these to calculate unique riders.
ev_ride_hailing_rapido_mau.methodology_notes: Monthly active users on Rapido app (auto, cab, bike taxi). Stock metric.

ev_ride_hailing_uber_mau.definition: App monthly active users; one person may use multiple mobility apps, so do not add these to calculate unique riders.
ev_ride_hailing_uber_mau.methodology_notes: Monthly active users on Uber app in India. Stock metric.

ev_ride_hailing_ola_mau.definition: App monthly active users; one person may use multiple mobility apps, so do not add these to calculate unique riders.
ev_ride_hailing_ola_mau.methodology_notes: Monthly active users on Ola Cabs app in India. Stock metric.

ev_ride_hailing_market_share.definition: Share of monthly active users, not share of rides, revenue, or GMV.
ev_ride_hailing_market_share.methodology_notes: MAU market share across major ride-hailing platforms in India. Stock metric.

ev_ride_hailing_daily_rides.definition: Ride-hailing MAU cannot be converted into daily rides without trip-frequency assumptions.
ev_ride_hailing_daily_rides.methodology_notes: Modelled daily trips benchmark. Requires explicit trip frequency assumptions. Flow metric.

ev_ride_hailing_market_size.definition: Ride-hailing market size may be measured by revenue, bookings, GMV, or trips; these are not interchangeable.
ev_ride_hailing_market_size.methodology_notes: Market size definition varies between gross bookings, net platform revenue, and GMV. Flow metric.

healthcare_market_size_2025.source_name: IBEF / Credence Research India healthcare market estimates

healthcare_total_health_expenditure_pct_.source_name: National Health Accounts Estimates for India 2021–22

healthcare_govt_health_expenditure_pct_g.source_name: National Health Accounts Estimates for India 2022–23 / 2021–22

economy_me_projected_sector_size_2030.notes: FICCI-EY M&E 2030 projection (~₹4.3L Cr at ~10% CAGR)

digital_social_media_avg_daily_time.definition: Average daily time spent per user across all social media apps combined

digital_youtube_premium_subscribers.definition: YouTube Premium paid subscribers in India
digital_youtube_premium_subscribers.methodology_notes: Estimated 8M–10M paid individual and family plan subscribers in India.

digital_ott_audience_total.definition: Total OTT video streaming audience in India (Free/AVOD + Paid/SVOD)
digital_ott_audience_total.methodology_notes: Total video streaming universe across AVOD and SVOD tiers; represents ~41% of India's population.

digital_ott_paying_households.definition: Unique households in India paying for at least one OTT streaming service
digital_ott_paying_households.methodology_notes: Estimated 45M–50M paying households, giving access to ~143M–150M individuals.
